description: Radar processing-frame index. All detected points belonging to the same radar processing frame share this value.
Lateral (cross-range) coordinate of the detected point in the radar Cartesian coordinate frame.
Forward-range (depth) coordinate of the detected point in the radar Cartesian coordinate frame.
Vertical (elevation) coordinate of the detected point in the radar Cartesian coordinate frame.
Radial Doppler velocity of the detected point relative to the radar sensor.
Signal-to-noise ratio of the detected radar reflection.
Unix epoch timestamp, in seconds, associated with the radar processing frame.
Target-tracker association identifier: 0-252 denote tracked targets; 253-255 denote noise or untracked points; and -1 denotes an unassigned point.
Camera-frame index for which an activity annotation is provided.
Activity label assigned to the corresponding camera frame. Label names are defined in metadata/label_taxonomy.csv.
Camera-frame index used to associate camera-derived activity annotations with timestamps.
Unix epoch timestamp, in seconds, associated with the corresponding camera frame. This timestamp can be matched with radar_data.csv timestamps to project camera-frame labels onto radar frames.
